lines.text: Crow was part of Heavenly Ascension too?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I don't know how she joined or who vouched for her.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: All I remember is hearing she was born in the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: At first, she was quiet, diligent, and devoted.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: She patrolled the Outer Rim with us,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: and went to the Ark with us to demand better rights.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: She went without hesitation to places other members avoided,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: and withstood all the physical and verbal abuse, and even the indifference.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: The reason I thought of her as a comrade, despite our philosophical differences,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: was because I saw how devoted she was then.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: But, at some point...

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: she stopped being quiet and started speaking up, raising her voice,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: and expanding her influence.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: While I was away from the Outer Rim to meet with the Central Government,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: she built up a small faction inside Heavenly Ascension. That's how much influence she'd gotten.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: You want to resort to... terrorism?
*Bang*

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: Are you out of your mind?!

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Whoa, whoa. Calm down.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Why're you getting so worked up?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Terrorism's a scary word. Don't call it that.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Since the Ark is so bright that the people there can't seem to see those of us who're living in darkness,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I'm just saying we should light off some fireworks to help them see better.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: Oh, don't try to make it sound harmless by calling it "fireworks."

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: Your plan is practically the definition of terrorism.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: You want to sneak bombs into key Central Government facilities and detonate them!

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: A ton of people in the Ark would die. It would be a castrophe.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Why should we care?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Let the bigwigs in the Ark deal with all that.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Do you think anyone in the Ark cares about us? About how many die of sickness,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: or how many children are going blind because there's no light,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: or how many are killed by explosives that got mixed in with the trash?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: We screamed our lungs out, but they didn't care one bit. It's the same thing.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: Our people dying from sickness or accidents isn't the same as outright murder!

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: And unlike us, the Ark has a super high-performance AI managing everything.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: C'mon, Boss. You've lived there before.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: You don't have to pretend like you haven't.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: We all know you came from the Ark.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: You...

lines.speaker: enterheavenman
lines.text: How dare you accuse Boss of being from the Ark!

lines.speaker: enterheavenman
lines.text: Do you have any idea what she's done for the Outer Rim?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Oh, of course I do.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I'm well aware of how hard our dear boss has worked for the Outer Rim,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: and how much has changed since she came here.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: How could I not?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: You're a good person, Boss.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Even I know that.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I doubt there's a single person in the Outer Rim who hasn't benefited from your efforts.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: We know how hard you've tried.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: That's why we've all followed you this whole time, including me.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: That'd never happen with anyone else.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: You threw everything away and came to the Outer Rim with nothing,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: then lived alongside us for years,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: and brought light to this dump that had been covered in darkness.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: But... what resulted from that?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: No one listens to us.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: No one remembers us.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Because it isn't sensational enough.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: That's the thing about people in the Ark.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Their lives are so peaceful, and they've had so much handed to them since birth,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: that you can ask them as sweetly and kindly as you want, even raise your voice,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: and they won't so much as spare you a glance.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: If it isn't sensational, they dismiss it as boring and couldn't care less.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: So what? What are you trying to say?

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: And how does this all lead to us becoming terrorists?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Terrorists? Didn't I say not to use scary words like that?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: We can still do what you want, Boss, and go into the Ark to tell them what we think.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: All I'm saying is we add a little spice to our words,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: that we do it the Outlaw way.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: We make it a game to get them more involved.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: If they find the bombs before they go off, the Ark wins.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: If they don't and the bombs go off first, we win.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: seeing how they already have so much,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: and we have so little,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: it's only fair that we apply just a tiny handicap to them:

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: we'll know the entire plan, but they won't.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Once they get engrossed in this little game of ours,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: they'll finally start listening to what we have to say.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I guarantee it.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: So...
Crow takes one more step toward Elysion Harper.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: ... just this once, I'd like us to do things my way.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: What do you say?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Boss.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: The looks in her eyes told me that she'd go through with it, even if it meant having to go through me.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: She spoke in a way to rile others up,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: highlighting how "we" were together in this,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: and sugar-coating her words to downplay the crime and make it feel justified.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Crow was an agitator, and a charismatic one at that.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: The others were starting to agree with more and more of what she said.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: ... And that's when I realized something.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Boss.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: What we need isn't to throw a tantrum like timid children.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: We need a revolution.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: One with fire and blood, because the truth is, those things can't be avoided if we're gonna get what we want.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: But that'll never happen if we do things your way, will it?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: That's why...

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I'm gonna do it instead.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: ... I realized I had to put a stop to it.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: I can't allow that.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: What you said it right.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: My way is peaceful and uneventful. It's never going to stir up the people of the Ark.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: I understand wanting to give them a shock.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: People might actually remember our name if we do.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: But,

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: killing people is a completely different story.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: All we'd be doing is giving them the go-ahead to shoot every one of us... And not just us, but everyone in the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: Like you said, we have nothing compared to them.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: That goes for firepower too.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: ... True.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: If they get serious and come here for blood,

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: we'd be lucky to escape, never mind defend ourselves.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: It wouldn't even be a fight.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: Of course, we've all snuck into the Ark before, so we might be able to flee there,

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: but what about everyone else in the Outer Rim?

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: The children.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: The sick.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: The elderly.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: Who's going to protect them?

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: And it's not just the Central Government.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: The reason we were able to make a pact with Underworld Queen...

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: wasn't because we were so determined that we'd shed blood for our cause,

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: but rather because we were protesting peacefully for our rights.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: If we do things your way, that pact would collapse.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: All the order that we've spent years establishing would collapse.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Order, huh...?

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: That's why I'll never approve of your plan.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: It's not just for our sake, but for everyone's.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Huh...

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: For everyone's sake...

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: You say you're afraid the Central Government will set their sights on all Outlaws,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: but that's easy enough to solve.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: We just change what we've been shouting this whole time.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: We stop saying, "Bring light to the Outer Rim, bring light to the Outlaws..."

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Instead, we make sure they know it's us.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: "Light is our right. Heavenly Ascension."

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: We change our slogan.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Then the government won't target everyone in the Outer Rim,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: but only Heavenly Ascension, right?

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: That's...

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: No...? Well, you're the boss!

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I get what you're worried about.
Crow picks up the paper with her plan on it.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Pretend I didn't say anything.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: ... Thanks for understanding.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Like I said... you're the boss.
Crow turns to leave, then stops.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: But,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: there is one thing you should know.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Not everyone's like you. They don't all worry about the other people in the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: And they're not all that patient, either.
Crow leaves the room.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: *Sigh...*

lines.speaker: enterheavenman
lines.text: She seems dangerous... Shouldn't we keep an eye on her?
Elysion Harper looks around the room.
A few people glance toward the door,
like they want to follow Crow out.

lines.speaker: elysionharper
lines.text: ... Yes. Please do.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I had a gut feeling, though,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: that her plan couldn't be stopped.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: From that day on, Heavenly Ascension split into two factions:

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: the moderates who wanted to raise their voices without straying too far from the old way,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: and the hard-liners who said the old way would never work, and that extreme measures were required.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Naturally, Crow led the hard-liners.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: At the time, both sides thankfully understood one other, even if they disagreed on which method to use.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: We at least knew why everyone chose the way they did,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: and the hard-liners didn't cross the line.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: But... as I feared, the hard-liners started kept getting more and more extreme.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: It didn't matter matter how much I tried to restrain them or persuade them otherwise.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: And before long, that ominous feeling I had was made a reality.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: The terrorist attack she had brought me that day was carried out in secret.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: ... They only changed the location.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: We've just received news of a terrible tragedy.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: A large-scale terrorist bombing has occurred on an AFX train operated by Elysion.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: The incident took place as the train was entering the station platform.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: The explosion, which came from within the passenger cars, not only destroyed the train, but also caused the station structure to collapse, resulting in a terrible tragedy.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: The Central Government has deployed numerous Nikkes to the site to conduct rescue operations,

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: but due to the extent of the collapse, the number of casualties continues to rise.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: Meanwhile, according to the testimony of one a survivor,

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: a passenger on the train stood up, pulled out a detonator, and shouted the following just before activating it.
The AFX Incident...

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: The worst terrorist attack in the Ark's history was set in motion by Crow...

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: "Light is our right! Heavenly Ascension!"

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: ... using her slogan.
